title: Sour and Oatzara Soup
description: A hearty and comforting soup perfect for a chilly evening. Oatzara adds a unique flavor to this classic recipe.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the oatzara and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the sour, water, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
